findings.location: worked example: classification of record D
findings.evidence: The example labels D "Unresolved/non-match" because no candidate rule exists. Candidate rules are optional under the contract, and D determinately fails the supplied exact and normalized comparisons because code Y9 differs from X7. The contract defines such a result as unmatched under the evaluated rule.
findings.consequence: The artifact conflates a reproducible non-match with an unresolved classification and implies that omitting an optional candidate rule makes ordinary rule failures unresolved.
findings.correction: Classify D as a non-match under the evaluated exact and normalized rules. Separately state that no candidate assessment can be made because no candidate rule was supplied; reserve unresolved classification for missing or conflicting rules needed for the attempted classification.
